video.title: Washington Wizards 2026/27 Season Preview: What You Need To Know!

summary: Josh Lloyd and Ben Strobe of Locked On Wizards preview the Washington Wizards for 2026/27. They say the rebuild is over: Washington added Trae Young and Anthony Davis last season, drafted AJ Dybantsa first overall, traded Jaden Hardy for Deandre Ayton and brought back Khris Middleton. Ben's projected starting five is Young, Kyshawn George, Dybantsa, Davis and Alex Sarr. He calls George the organization's favorite young wing, says Young will still run the offense, and is very high on Sarr, who is coming back from a fractured foot. Defense is the big question, with Steve Clifford joining the coaching staff. Ben predicts about 40 wins and a play-in spot. For fantasy, the main takeaway is that the Wizards should no longer rest players or cut their minutes like a tanking team, so their players are easier to trust.

rules.text: Players on a team that is trying to win are easier to trust in fantasy than players on a tanking team. Tanking teams pull players after three quarters and sit them for much of March.
